INDIA AVAILABILITY: India is not among the 20 restricted CFD countries listed by FundedNext on April 8, 2026. This does not constitute regulatory approval or legal advice.

INDIA CHECKOUT: International Cards accepts Visa, Mastercard and Amex, with cardholder name required to match the FundedNext account. The site also advertises 30 cryptocurrencies; any Local Payment option is country-dependent and must appear in the user's dashboard.
KYC: physical national ID, passport or residence permit plus liveness check; the help center says review typically takes 48 hours and profile KYC renews every 90 days.
PAYOUT ROUTES: USDT/USDC can be requested from $20 up to $1,999 on standard routes, RiseWorks from $50, and bank transfer from $1,000 to $50,000. Provider processing fees can be up to 3.5%.

notes: Stellar Instant is a simulated instant-funded product with no evaluation phase and no refundable fee.
The starting Reward Share is 70%, not the 80% ceiling reached from Tier 3.
On-demand payout eligibility requires 5% account growth and an EOD check; 1%-to-under-5% growth uses a 14-day cycle.
The 6% maximum loss trails upward with profit, locks at starting balance, and does not reset after a withdrawal.
News-window profits are counted at only 40%; full losses remain.
